'''spideyguy0 Bring Him Before Me- Player's Preconstruct 8''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[spideyguy0]]
* '''Published:''' 5 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM spideyguy0 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The 8th preconstruct.

The published list has 68 cards.
